messages:
Sachin (eng-ml): Heads up — possible new base model 'Stagelight-6B' surfaced from a community repo. Model card: https://huggingface.co/stagelight/6b. License file appears to include a non-commercial clause and a restriction on redistribution of weights. Need legal triage + permission check before any hosting or quantized redistribution.

Mira (legal): Non-commercial + redistribution prohibition = can't offer via hosted API or Dedicated paid customers. We need the exact license text and any contributor CLA. :eyes:

Sachin (eng-ml): Pasted the relevant lines from the repo README we found: ```LICENSE: NonCommercialOnly
WEIGHTS: redistribution forbidden without author consent``` — not verbatim but that's the gist. No mention of dual/commercial license on the page.

Mira (legal): Can you drop the repo link and the exact LICENSE file into the intake ticket? If redistribution is prohibited, quantized weights are still a derived artifact and fall under that restriction. Internal evals are usually OK for research, but not production.

Jordan (infra): Also note: we need to run an export-control checklist. Any models trained on scraped data with certain categories can trigger additional controls. From infra side, sandbox-only eval (no external egress) is required until legal clears.

Natasha (product): Quick Q: How urgent is this? A lead customer mentioned interest in a low-cost 6B option. If legal can get a commercial license, this could be prioritized. Otherwise we should deprioritize.

Mike R. (eng-ml): For quantization: converting to 4-bit/gptq produces a derivative. If we can't redistribute original weights, we can't ship quantized variants either. I can run local evals (per @Jordan sandbox) — baseline FP16 vs q4 vs int8, check for regressions on our eval set. Will need ~24h GPU.

Mira (legal): Proposed next steps: 1) capture full license file + snapshot the repo (timestamp + hash). 2) Reach out to maintainers requesting commercial license or explicit redistribution permission for quantized weights. 3) If maintainers don't agree, we can perform internal-only evals but must not host or sell. I'll draft outreach. Assign: Mira. ETA 48h.

Sachin (eng-ml): Triage checklist I'm adding to intake ticket: - repo snapshot + LICENSE file - provenance notes (training data notes) - sample eval (1k prompts) - quantization smoke tests in isolated VPC - export-control quick scan - legal outreach email record. Tagging @Jordan for sandbox and @Mike R. for eval runs.

InfraBot: New intake ticket created: https://notion.redwood/s/abcd-1234 (RDW-4021) — owners: Sachin, Mike R., Mira.

Jordan (infra): Provisioning sandbox GPU for initial run: g5.12xlarge (24h). Network egress disabled, snapshots blocked, logs forwarded to compliance bucket. Will post creds in RDW-4021. :thumbsup:

Natasha (product): If legal can secure a paid license in <1 week, I can bump priority and talk to the interested customer (no commitments until it's cleared).

Mike R. (eng-ml): Plan for evals: 1) run 500 prompt subset with our quality suite (accuracy, hallucination rate, safety classifiers), 2) run q4_gptq and int8 tests, 3) compare latency and token cost. Will upload a short report to RDW-4021 within 48h of runs.

Mira (legal): Draft outreach email (working copy): ```Hi [Maintainers], we're from Redwood Inference. We're interested in commercial licensing or explicit permission to redistribute quantized/converted weights of Stagelight-6B for hosted/dedicated use. Could you share commercial licensing options or accept a dual-license? Also please confirm any dataset provenance statements. Thank you.```

Sachin (eng-ml): Thanks. I'll snapshot the repo and attach LICENSE text to RDW-4021 now. Will update this thread with author replies. For now, keep evaluations internal-only until legal gives the green light. :white_check_mark:

LegalBot: Reminder — capture authorship names & CLA status. If authors are anonymous or ambiguous, raise IP concern flag.

Mike R. (eng-ml): Noted. Will include a note if weights contain third-party checkpoints that may alter license status.

Mira (legal): If we get a conditional permission (e.g., commercial ok but no redistribution), we can still offer hosted inference by NOT distributing weights and running only in our data centers — but need to confirm indemnity/SLAs with the authors. That's a potential path if redistribution blocked.

Sachin (eng-ml): Good point. I'll add that as an option in RDW-4021 (host-only arrangement). Closing interim — will report back with maintainer response or license copy.

Jordan (infra): Ping me if you need longer sandbox time.

Natasha (product): Thanks all. Keep me looped for customer comms.

Sachin (eng-ml): Thread closed for now, reopening on author reply.
